parent_objective: design a new low-margin data route after closing the geometry-only retarget branch

public_gates: M810 designs only a new data route
M810 does not weaken the primary low-margin threshold
M810 preserves the P0 human-view no-wheel actor contract
M810 keeps M804/M807 half-width rows as limited debug data only
M810 blocks residual calibration, PPO, and promotion
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train actor or residual parameters
do not weaken the primary 0.00005 margin threshold
do not treat M804 or M807 half-width rows as a source-diverse pass
do not claim true wheel-level faults from current single-track proxy data
do not tune from private holdout failures

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_distribution: new source-diverse near-boundary data route design
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a fresh route after the M800-M809 branch pivot instead of extending fixed-anchor retargeting
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no replay calibration PPO or promotion
stop_condition: stop if the design is just another narrow retarget-axis tweak
stop if it weakens the primary low-margin threshold
stop if it requires deploy-time oracle inputs
stop if it claims real wheel-level failures without simulator support
fallback_plan: if active diagnostic history is infeasible, design terminal local correction data instead
if current simulator cannot generate source diversity, write simulator-fidelity planning
if design is too broad, split implementation into no-training corpus export before any calibration
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M809 pivots away from the geometry-only low-margin retarget branch

hypothesis: A new data route that combines active diagnostic history, joint obstacle/fault timing, and source-balanced near-boundary mining can target the missing low-margin source diversity better than more fixed-anchor retargeting.
success_criteria: M810 designs a concrete no-training data route
M810 defines source fault and axis diversity gates before implementation
M810 defines how active diagnostic history or warm-up evidence is collected without oracle actor inputs
M810 records current-model proxy limits for future wheel-level faults
M810 keeps residual calibration, PPO, and promotion blocked
failure_criteria: design admits calibration or PPO directly
design reuses M804/M807 half-width rows as if they were source-diverse
design weakens the primary low-margin threshold
design overclaims current single-track proxy faults as true wheel-level physics
decision_rule: M810 may only design the next data route. It must not train, run PPO, mutate actor or residual parameters, or promote a checkpoint.
